definition: ParticipantNonidentity quantifies over every admitted quality q, every Form f of q and every entity x: participation of x in f implies f ≠ x, including when x is another Form. It neither defines ontological independence nor follows from particulars-only nonidentity.
note: Explicit semantic boundary for issue #258. The cited primary readings motivate research premises without defining this modern finite-list encoding. A sourced replacement would need to settle precisely these quantifiers, domains and predication senses.
